data.title: Secret trigger words could make AI-powered robots dangerous—and these researchers developed a defense - Binghamton News
data.description: A team of computer scientists at Binghamton University has demonstrated that hidden trigger words inserted maliciously into LLMs could cause a robot to go off-script and perform dangerous actions—and they developed a defense.
